# Crescendo

> High-throughput workflow automation platform built on Java 25 Virtual Threads, Redis Streams, and PostgreSQL. Features 114+ native app integrations, a visual node canvas, Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AES-256-GCM envelope encryption, transactional email orchestration, and an Agentic AI ReAct runtime.

## Core URLs
- Web Platform: https://app.crescendo.run
- Documentation: https://app.crescendo.run/docs
- Full LLM Knowledge Base: https://app.crescendo.run/llms-full.txt
- GitHub Monorepo: https://github.com/AnkitArsh19/crescendo
- SDK Ecosystem: https://github.com/AnkitArsh19/crescendo-sdk

## Architecture Highlights
- **Engine**: Spring Boot 4 + Java 25 (`spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true`) for non-blocking I/O.
- **Queueing & Pub/Sub**: Redis Streams (`ExecutionQueueConsumer`) with manual ACK for idempotent processing and zero-loss reliability under traffic spikes.
- **Database**: CQRS pattern isolating write transactions (`crescendo_command`) from analytics and dashboard reads (`crescendo_query`).
- **Distributed Rate Limiting**: Atomic Redis Lua Token Bucket algorithm mitigating brute-force and DDoS without lock contention.
- **Secrets Management**: Authenticated AES-256-GCM envelope encryption at rest. Decrypted API keys reside strictly in volatile heap memory during live step execution handshakes. Plaintext secrets are never committed to disk or logged.
- **Authentication**: Modern identity architecture supporting FIDO2 / WebAuthn Passkeys, TOTP MFA, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and refresh token rotation with automated reuse detection.
- **Transactional Email**: Embedded email service with DKIM, SPF, DMARC DNS verification, open/click telemetry tracking, and bounce suppression lists.
- **AI / ML Runtime**: FastAPI Python microservice with Google Gemini, Groq, and OpenAI tool-calling for natural language workflow generation.

## Legal, Trust & Compliance
- **GDPR (EU 2016/679) & UK GDPR**: Fully compliant Data Processing Addendum (DPA) incorporating European Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
- **India DPDP Act (2023)**: Full compliance with data principal rights, notice requirements, and designated Grievance Redressal Officer.
- **California CCPA/CPRA**: Zero sale or sharing of user personal data.
- **Zero AI Model Training Guarantee**: Proprietary workflow definitions, prompt instructions, and audience subscriber data are never used to train foundation models.
- **Security Policy (RFC 9116)**: https://app.crescendo.run/.well-known/security.txt
